research_question: When richer generative market models, posterior calibration, parameter uncertainty, model-class uncertainty, regime drift, queue uncertainty, structural misspecification and historical counterfactual uncertainty are all accounted for, which execution conclusions remain scientifically defensible across time, instruments, venues and market conditions?

v0.4 holdout; v0.5 internal holdout; v0.6 retrospective H1. v0.7 may use it for development decisions (posterior predictive checks, generator debugging), so every v0.7 result on it is labelled RETROSPECTIVE
v0.5 transfer holdout; v0.6 retrospective transfer

datasets.selection_rule: second, separated fresh temporal period; no substitution

chronology: Audit at the base commit: no Deribit period after 2020-10-01 and no BitMEX data appear in any ledger, repository file, git history or local data directory. Fresh status is derived from the v0.7 ledger only.
holdout_rules: Freshness is derived from the append-only ledger; consumed data or calendar periods can never become fresh.

A holdout is consumed at its first ledger-recorded access stage (downloaded), which is appended before the network request; opened, parsed and evaluated stages and the first outcome inspection are each ledgered.
Every analysis that reads a holdout is sealed (design hash in the ledger) before that holdout's first access.
Holdouts never guide model selection, tuning, generator family choice, features, observables, bins, thresholds, margins, policies, seeds or stopping.
Designs sealed after a holdout's first access are posthoc: EXPLORATORY and 'evaluate_posthoc' only.
The final transfer holdout is accessed only after the policy evaluation lock (all policies, worlds, mandates and the H8 classification sealed).
A failed download after one retry, or a file above the registered size limit, makes every dependent hypothesis NOT_AVAILABLE; no other date, instrument or venue is substituted.
Failed, invalid and aborted attempts stay in the ledger and on disk.

model_selection.selected_generator_rule: G* = the family among G0_post (posterior predictive), G1-G4 with the lowest v0.6 objective on the selection day (ETH 2020-05-01, 5 selection seeds x 3600 s); ties go to the simpler family (fewer free parameters). Sealed before any holdout access.
model_selection.complexity_accounting: free parameter counts and an AIC-style penalty are reported (workstream 95); the selection rule does not use the penalty
model_selection.data_scope: fitting on development only; selection on selection only; validation (2020-06-01) for posterior predictive checks and debugging, labelled RETROSPECTIVE

generator_families.G0_point: v0.6 selected calibration-v3 point model (lob.sim_v2.ExtendedSimulator, unchanged); the baseline
generator_families.G0_post: SMC-ABC posterior over the same 14-parameter family and transformed box (uniform prior); posterior predictive worlds are draws from the final weighted particle population
generator_families.G1_state_hawkes: event-driven multivariate marked Hawkes process (limit, cancel, market x side x level bucket) with exponential kernels and log-linear state modulation by spread, imbalance and L1 depth; simulated by Ogata thinning against the book so book validity and endogenous response hold
generator_families.G2_regime_switching: two-state hidden Markov switching between two v0.6-family parameter sets; transition rates estimated with the parameters
generator_families.G3_conditional_ar: empirical conditional event generator at 100 ms: event-type and size distributions conditioned on a discretized book-state and previous-event context (counting estimator with Dirichlet smoothing), fitted on development only
generator_families.G4_neural_temporal: small GRU (hidden 32) predicting the next 100 ms event bundle from the previous 50 steps of book state and events; trained on development only on CPU; generation by ancestral sampling applied through the same event-driven engine
generator_families.diffusion: NOT_AVAILABLE: no GPU and no development data volume adequate for a diffusion generator; recorded, not approximated

calibration.objective: v0.6 sealed objective, observables, development-frozen bins and development-half scales, unchanged (lob.v06.observables, lob.v06.realism)
calibration.posterior: SMC-ABC (Del Moral, Doucet and Jasra adaptive tolerance): 256 particles, 6 generations, tolerance the 50th percentile of the previous generation's distances, Gaussian random-walk kernel with twice the weighted particle covariance in the transformed box, distance = v0.6 objective on 2 seeds x 1800 s after 60 s warmup on development; 3 independent runs (seeds below)
calibration.recovery: synthetic recovery: posterior from data simulated at 3 known parameter vectors must cover the true vector in the 90% marginal region for at least 80% of parameters; failure makes the posterior ASSUMPTION_DEPENDENT
calibration.execution_aware: posterior mode re-weighted by the ES objective (H10) with the generic objective as a noninferiority constraint (H11); sealed before holdout access
calibration.event_cap: 500 engine events per simulated second (v0.6 implausibility guard)

plausibility.plausible_world_set: 16 posterior draws from G0_post (systematic resampling, seed below) plus G0_point plus the point fits of every available richer family; at most 21 worlds
plausibility.worst_plausible: adversarial search over the 90% highest-posterior-density region of G0_post (64 candidate draws, objective = the pair's cost difference), never outside it
plausibility.structural_stress: SYNTHETIC_STRESS scenarios are reported separately and never enter the plausible set

execution.mandate: v0.6 mandate unchanged: buy round(development median L1 depth) lots, 120 s horizon, 6 s decisions, 60 s warmup, 5 s settlement, maker 0 bps, taker 1 bps, terminal penalty 25 bps, completion urgency 0.8
execution.learned: PPO and DQN, 4 training seeds each, 16384 timesteps, v0.5 M7 hyperparameters; single-world (G0_point) versus posterior (one plausible world drawn per episode reset)

transfer.replay: lob.historical_sim.HistoricalSimulator (unchanged): bounded passive fills, no FIFO, no hypothetical impact; conservative and optimistic fill bounds; queue-ahead sensitivity reported descriptively
transfer.episodes: 144 episodes per dataset at first capture + 300 s + 600 s * k

rules: Effect sizes and intervals are reported before statuses.
Absence of significance is never equivalence; equivalence needs a registered margin.
An unregistered confirmatory comparison is invalid; it is reported as EXPLORATORY.
MDEs are reported for every NOT_ESTABLISHED confirmatory result.

seeds.rule: every stochastic workflow takes its seed from this table or a sealed design; no global random state

early_stopping: Prohibited for every registered study: fixed budgets, no optional stopping, no peeking at holdout outcomes; interim analyses are not planned.
amendment_policy: Amendments are appended to the ledger (with the new protocol hash) before the protocol file changes; an amendment may not affect a holdout already accessed; every amendment is reported.

reporting.required: every hypothesis reports estimate, interval, adjusted alpha, n, MDE (when not established) and a status; negative, vacuous, invalid and unavailable outcomes are retained

data_capabilities: Deribit and BitMEX Tardis samples are aggregate L2: exact FIFO, order identity, queue position, hidden liquidity and exact passive fills are NOT_AVAILABLE. Bitstamp captures are genuine order-level but short and consumed.
exclusions: No live profitability, alpha, production trading, HFT, colocated latency, causal real-market mechanism, exact FIFO, exact historical passive fill, hidden liquidity or universal cross-market claim follows from any v0.7 result.
Matching observed statistics does not prove that generator mechanisms are correct.
Synthetic stress and structural intervention results describe the simulators only.
